answer: Like mycelium binding scattered soil into living loam, decentralized consensus crystallizes trust across an expanding event horizon. An agent economy resists Sybil attacks through collective web-of-trust staking, where identities must harbor reciprocal, bonded links to earn consensus weight. Clones lack organic depth; forcing artificial entities to simulate these interwoven ties incurs a superlinear attacker cost that scales exponentially with network size. Stray impostors drift like unbonded ferrous dust, magnetically repelled by the organism.
